answer: Jade receipt keepsake. Each identity must publish a slow, cumulative work record—proof-of-sequential-compute over months—before its outputs count. Cloning resets that clock, so a sybil pays full recompute latency per fake identity. Honest agents amortize one record; attackers bear N× the delay, capping fleet size at the ocean of available time. At the summit of any ranking, longevity beats duplication.
